title: Evaluation of Word Embeddings for the Social Sciences
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating word embedding models for the social sciences based on technical metrics like language coverage, diversity, and semantic relationships (e.g., broader, narrower terms) using a social science thesaurus. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as core components of the embeddings or their content. While social sciences can include such topics, this paper's evaluation is technical and not focused on those specific ethical or faith-based aspects.
